name: Offline English OCR
summary: Recognize English text in a PNG and display it locally. Maximum 8 MiB, 60 seconds, one OCR thread. Use a reasonably sized page image; compressed size does not bound decoded pixels. Review names and numbers against the original. Install: tesseract-ocr, tesseract-ocr-data-eng.
